description: Move some or all of an item's quantity to another folder (items only — relocate a folder with sortly_update_item parent_id). A partial move splits off a new item with the same sid; a full move relocates the item; a matching item at the destination is merged, and the returned id is the destination's. Undo by moving it back. WRITE. Sortly: POST /api/v1/items/{item_id}/move.

folder_id.description: Destination folder. Omit to move to the root level.

leave_zero_quantity.description: Keep a zero-quantity record in the source folder. Default false.

name: sortly_move_item
title: Move stock to another folder
